title: Reduce, Reuse, Redeem: Deposit-Refund Recycling Programs in the Presence of Alternatives
abstract: Understanding how consumers make recycling decisions is crucial in crafting sustainable recycling policies. We estimate consumer preferences and willingness to pay for current beverage container recycling methods, including curbside pick-up services, drop-off at government-subsidized recycling centers, and drop-off at non-subsidized centers. Using a representative online and telephone survey of California households, we estimate a revealed preference discrete choice model that identifies the key attributes explaining consumers’ beverage container disposal decisions, including the ability to receive a deposit refund (paid to consumers only if they recycle at drop-off centers) and the effort associated with bringing recyclable materials to recycling centers. Additionally, we use counterfactual policy analysis to show that increasing the refund amount increases overall household recycling rates. Infra–marginal households who are on the boundary between taking containers to recycling centers and recycling using curbside pick-up, namely white households and households with higher educational attainment, see the largest changes in consumer surplus generated by increasing refund payments. Conversely, we show that eliminating government-subsidized drop-off centers does not significantly alter consumer surplus for any major demographic group, and has little impact on whether a household chooses to recycle.
abstract_zh: 理解消费者如何做出回收决策，对于制定可持续的回收政策至关重要。我们估计了消费者对当前饮料容器回收方式的偏好及其支付意愿，这些方式包括路边上门收集服务、在政府补贴的回收中心投递，以及在非补贴回收中心投递。利用对加利福尼亚州家庭进行的、具有代表性的在线与电话调查，我们估计了一个显示性偏好离散选择模型，该模型识别出解释消费者饮料容器处置决策的关键属性，包括能否获得押金退款（仅在投递至回收中心时支付给消费者）以及将可回收材料运送至回收中心所需付出的努力。此外，我们运用反事实政策分析表明，提高退款金额可以提高家庭总体回收率。处于将容器送至回收中心与通过路边收集回收之间边界的边际家庭（即白人家庭以及受教育程度较高的家庭），其消费者剩余因提高押金退款而发生的变化最大。相反，我们表明，取消政府补贴的投递中心并不会显著改变任何主要人口群体的消费者剩余，对家庭是否选择回收的影响也很小。

Can a Sustainability Facts Label Reduce the Halo Surrounding Organic Labels?
abstract: Consumers often form beliefs about credence attributes unsupported by the best available evidence. In particular, prior research has revealed many consumers have overly‐optimistic beliefs about the environmental and nutritional impacts of organic food. We propose and study the effects of a sustainability facts label (SFL), which displays quantitative environmental information related to global warming potential, land use, and energy use per serving size of the product. The SFL is akin to a nutrition facts label (NFL), which we also study. We surveyed a nationally representative sample of milk consumers in the United States (USA) to measure their choices and beliefs about organic vs. conventional milk under one of three different label information treatments; the NFL only, the SFL only, and both labels relative to a control without any nutrition or sustainability information. Unexpectedly, our results show that the SFL increased the likelihood of organic purchases. Facts panels altered beliefs; The participants exposed to the SFL increased their perception that organic performs better on environmental metrics, despite the fact the information contained in the label provided a nuanced picture with organic better in some dimensions and worse in others. Consistent with the information provided, consumers exposed to the NFL decreased their perception that organic had fewer calories and more protein than conventional milk. Prior beliefs about organic were found to be important determinants of choice and information acquisition.
abstract_zh: 消费者往往会对某些信任属性形成信念，而这些信念并未得到现有最佳证据的支持。尤其是，既有研究发现，许多消费者对有机食品的环境与营养影响抱有过于乐观的信念。我们提出并研究了“可持续性事实标签”（SFL）的效果，该标签按每份产品的食用量，展示与全球变暖潜势、土地利用和能源利用相关的量化环境信息。SFL类似于我们同时研究的“营养事实标签”（NFL）。我们对美国具有全国代表性的牛奶消费者样本进行了调查，以衡量在三种不同标签信息处理之下（仅NFL、仅SFL，以及两种标签同时呈现，与不提供任何营养或可持续性信息的对照组相比），他们对有机牛奶与常规牛奶的选择和信念。出乎意料的是，我们的结果表明，SFL提高了购买有机产品的可能性。事实标签改变了信念：接触到SFL的参与者提高了对有机产品在环境指标上表现更好的认知，尽管标签所载信息呈现的是一幅细致入微的图景——有机产品在某些维度上更好，在另一些维度上更差。与所提供的信息相一致，接触到NFL的消费者降低了对有机牛奶热量更低、蛋白质更高于常规牛奶的认知。研究发现，关于有机产品的先验信念是决定选择与信息获取的重要因素。

Pollution and Fatal Traffic Accidents in California Counties
abstract: This paper estimates the effect of fine particulate matter P M2.5 on fatal traffic accidents in California using daily county-level data from 1999 to 2019. Pollution can affect visibility or the cognitive abilities of drivers, leading to traffic accidents. However, driving also leads to an increase in pollution, potentially leading to reverse causality. The goal of this paper is to estimate the causal effect of pollution on fatal traffic accidents using instrumental variables. Using variation in P M2.5 due to air temperature inversions and eastward wind, we find that P M2.5 has a positive effect on fatal car accidents. Fatalities increase on average by 0.18% when P M2.5 increases by 1 μg/m3, resulting in 55 more fatalities per year in California.  Our identification strategy estimates the causal effect using exogenous variation in P M2.5 due to factors that drivers are exposed to while driving. Heterogeneity analysis finds, for one, that this mechanism is worsened for lower-income counties. On the other hand, this mechanism is mitigated by driver risk aversion during extremely poor air quality days and during days when there are temperature inversions during the day.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1999至2019年加利福尼亚州县级的日度数据，估计细颗粒物PM2.5对致命交通事故的影响。污染可能影响驾驶员的能见度或认知能力，从而导致交通事故。然而，驾车本身也会增加污染，从而可能产生反向因果。本文的目的是利用工具变量估计污染对致命交通事故的因果效应。利用逆温层和东风所引起的PM2.5变化，我们发现PM2.5对致命车祸具有正向影响。当PM2.5每增加1微克/立方米时，死亡人数平均增加0.18%，这意味着加利福尼亚州每年多出55人死亡。我们的识别策略利用了由驾驶员在驾车过程中所暴露的因素而引起的PM2.5外生变化来估计因果效应。异质性分析发现，一方面，该机制在低收入县份更为严重；另一方面，在空气质量极差的日子以及白天出现逆温层的日子，驾驶员的风险厌恶会减弱这一机制。

title: Recycling Behavior and Convenience
venue: Sustainable Resource Development in the 21st Century (Springer), chapter
abstract: This chapter provides a comprehensive review of the current state of California’s recycling policies. Specifically, we focus on the demand side of the recycling system and summarize some of the evidence around the efficacy of the California Department of Recycling’s (CalRecycle) deposit-refund recycling program – in conjunction with other recycling alternatives, such as curbside recycling pickup – in providing convenient recycling options to consumers. In Sect. 2, we provide some relevant background on recycling policy in California. In Sect. 3, we discuss the findings in Berck et al. (2021), which uses survey data to empirically assess who recycles and how the public defines convenience in recycling opportunities. Next, in Sect. 4, we present the main takeaways from Berck et al. (2020), which focuses on the consumer survey evidence to estimate California residents’ preferences and willingness to pay (WTP) for current beverage container recycling methods, including curbside pickup services, drop-off at government-subsidized recycling centers, and drop-off at non-subsidized centers. Finally, in Sect. 5, we discuss avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本章全面回顾了加利福尼亚州回收政策的现状。具体而言，我们关注回收体系的需求侧，并总结了关于加州回收部（CalRecycle）押金退款回收计划的有效性的部分证据，该计划与路边回收收集等其他回收方式共同为消费者提供便捷的回收选择。在第2节，我们提供了加州回收政策的相关背景。在第3节，我们讨论了Berck等人（2021）的研究发现，该研究利用调查数据实证评估了谁在回收，以及公众如何界定回收渠道的便利性。接下来，在第4节，我们介绍了Berck等人（2020）的主要结论，该研究基于消费者调查证据，估计加州居民对当前饮料容器回收方式的偏好及支付意愿，这些方式包括路边上门收集服务、在政府补贴的回收中心投递，以及在非补贴回收中心投递。最后，在第5节，我们讨论了未来的研究方向。

abstract: AB2020 established a deposit‐refund system in California, where consumers are reimbursed the California Redemption Value (CRV) upon recycling eligible containers at a recycling center. We study recycling under this policy, focusing on consumer convenience, reported recycling and diversion behavior, and responses to changes in the CRV amount. We find that consumers prefer nearby centers with flexible operating hours and short waiting times. While the CRV induces recycling, an increase in CRV would not lead to major recycling increases, given the limited number of containers entering trash streams. Finally, most diverted containers are taken from trash streams, not curbside recycling bins.
abstract_zh: AB2020法案在加利福尼亚州建立了押金退款制度，消费者在回收中心回收合格容器后，可获得加州回收价值（CRV）的返还。我们研究了该政策下的回收行为，重点关注消费者的便利性、自我报告的回收与分流行为，以及对CRV金额变动的反应。我们发现，消费者偏好营业时间灵活、等待时间较短的近距离回收中心。尽管CRV能够促进回收，但鉴于进入垃圾流的容器数量有限，提高CRV不会带来回收量的大幅增加。最后，大多数被分流的容器来自垃圾流，而非路边回收箱。

The impact of ecolabels and green taxes on market outcomes
abstract: Ecolabels and green taxes aim to achieve more sustainable market outcomes by affecting suppliers’ production and sales behaviour, consumers’ purchasing behaviour, or both. In this chapter, we present the economic rationale for how these approaches may impact suppliers and consumers in various settings and review recent published empirical research on the topic. We focus specifically on examples where ecolabels and green taxes have been used to protect oceans and fisheries by reducing plastic waste and reducing purchases of less sustainable seafood. We conclude by discussing other possible policy instruments and highlight important avenues for future work in pursuing more sustainable market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 生态标签与绿色税收旨在通过影响供应商的生产与销售行为、消费者的购买行为，或二者兼而有之，以实现更加可持续的市场结果。在本章中，我们阐述了这些手段在不同情境下可能影响供应商和消费者的经济学逻辑，并回顾了关于该主题的近期已发表的实证研究。我们特别关注生态标签与绿色税收被用于保护海洋和渔业的案例，即通过减少塑料废弃物以及减少对可持续性较差海产品的购买。最后，我们讨论了其他可能的政策工具，并指出了未来在追求更可持续市场结果方面的重要研究方向。
